records.source: Ah, the sewers are flowing quickly today. It'll get nice and humid in here... just how I like it.
records.translation: Ah, mabilis ang agos ng mga imburnal ngayon. Magiging kaaya-ayang mahalumigmig dito... gustong-gusto ko iyan.

records.source: The idea of an egg hunt is a little bit weird... but I guess the eggs don't belong to any of my family members...$s#$b#Oh well, I'll join in anyway!$h
records.translation: Medyo kakaiba ang ideya ng paghahanap ng itlog... pero mukhang hindi naman pag-aari ng sinuman sa pamilya ko ang mga itlog...$s#$b#Ayos lang, sasali pa rin ako!$h

records.source: $y 'Do you think I'm too old to do the egg hunt?_Yes_Hmmph... you sound like my Mom!$a_No_Yeah, I guess so. If I'm still having fun, why stop?'
records.translation: $y 'Masyado na ba akong matanda para sumali sa paghahanap ng itlog?_Oo_Hmph... parang nanay ko kung magsalita!$a_Hindi_Oo nga. Kung nagsasaya pa rin ako, bakit ako titigil?'

records.source: It feels great to be outside again after that long, cold winter, doesn't it?
records.translation: Ang sarap makalabas muli matapos ang mahaba at malamig na taglamig, hindi ba?

records.source: Hey @, did you get a taste of my carp roe pie?#$b#...What? It is the 'egg' festival, isn't it?
records.translation: Hoy, @, natikman mo ba ang pie ko na may itlog ng karpa?#$b#...Ano? Pista ng 'itlog' naman ito, hindi ba?

records.source: Think you'll win the egg hunt this year?
records.translation: Sa tingin mo, mananalo ka sa paghahanap ng itlog ngayong taon?

records.source: You know what? I kind of miss the winter... it's simpler, in a way.
records.translation: Alam mo? Medyo hinahanap-hanap ko ang taglamig... mas payak ang buhay noon.

records.source: I'll just slip in a little later and have some food. I'm eyeing that scrumptious looking pie!
records.translation: Palihim na lang akong papasok maya-maya at kakain. Gustong-gusto ko iyong mukhang napakasarap na pie!

records.source: Trying to make a back-room deal, huh? Hah! I admire your gumption.
records.translation: Sinusubukan mong makipagkasundo nang palihim, ano? Hah! Hinahangaan ko ang tapang mo.

records.source: It may be a little boring, but these festivals are a good chance to connect with our neighbors.
records.translation: Maaaring medyo nakakabagot, pero magandang pagkakataon ang mga pistang ito para mapalapit sa ating mga kapitbahay.

records.source: I wonder what would happen to my arms and legs if I ate thirty eggs a day?
records.translation: Ano kaya ang mangyayari sa mga braso at binti ko kung kakain ako ng tatlumpung itlog araw-araw?

records.source: Evelyn made eggs and leeks for breakfast, so I'm in a good mood.$h
records.translation: Nagluto si Evelyn ng mga itlog at sibuyas-pranses para sa almusal, kaya maganda ang timpla ko.$h

records.source: $y 'Do you have hens on your farm?_Yes_Oh, good! I'm sure they lay the most delicious eggs...$h_No_Spring would be a great time to start raising chickens, don't you think?'
records.translation: $y 'May mga inahin ka ba sa bukid mo?_Oo_O, mabuti! Tiyak akong napakasarap ng mga itlog nila...$h_Hindi_Magandang panahon ang tagsibol para magsimulang mag-alaga ng mga manok, hindi ba?'

records.source: Oh no... *gulp*... It's mostly salad this year...$s
records.translation: Ay, hindi... *lunok*... Puro salad halos ngayong taon...$s

records.source: Hopefully Vincent will be able to find an egg this year... #$b#It would be good for him to feel like he's a contender.
records.translation: Sana makahanap si Vincent ng isang itlog ngayong taon... #$b#Makabubuti sa kaniya ang maramdamang may laban siya.

records.source: Hey... If you're gonna feed me eggs, I'm gonna need some hot sauce, kid!
records.translation: Hoy... Kung pakakainin ninyo ako ng mga itlog, kailangan ko ng maanghang na sarsa, bata!

records.source: This year I sewed little pants and hats for some of the eggs. They look adorable!$h
records.translation: Ngayong taon, gumawa ako ng maliliit na pantalon at sombrero para sa ilan sa mga itlog. Napakakatuwa nilang tingnan!$h

records.source: Oh! I still need to get my photo taken at the bunny stand. Does my hair look okay?
records.translation: Oh! Kailangan ko pa palang magpakuha ng larawan sa puwesto ng kuneho. Ayos ba ang buhok ko?

records.source: Kent always seems a little antsy during big gatherings like this...
records.translation: Laging parang balisa si Kent sa malalaking pagtitipong tulad nito...

records.source: Have you ever hunted for slime eggs? Now there's a true challenge...
records.translation: Nakapaghanap ka na ba ng mga itlog ng Slime? Iyan ang tunay na hamon...

records.source: Hmm... The punch isn't as good as last year. It's missing something!
records.translation: Hmm... Hindi kasingsarap noong nakaraang taon ang punch. May kulang!

records.source: Some of these eggs were laid just this morning. See? They're still warm!
records.translation: Kaninang umaga lang ipinangitlog ang ilan sa mga ito. Kita mo? Mainit-init pa!

records.source: Hens lay the eggs, but roosters play an important role, too... they protect the hens and prevent them from fighting with each other!#$b#That means happier hens and better eggs...$h
records.translation: Ang mga inahin ang nangingitlog, pero mahalaga rin ang tungkulin ng mga tandang... pinoprotektahan nila ang mga inahin at pinipigilan silang mag-away-away!#$b#Ibig sabihin, mas masasayang inahin at mas magagandang itlog...$h

records.source: Be careful you don't accidentally take a raven's egg. They'll hold a grudge against you for the rest of their days!
records.translation: Mag-ingat na hindi ka aksidenteng makapulot ng itlog ng uwak. Habang-buhay silang magtatanim ng galit sa iyo!

records.source: Shh... don't tell anyone, but I tried something different this year... Duck eggs in the custard!$h
records.translation: Shh... huwag mong sabihin kaninuman, pero may iba akong sinubukan ngayong taon... Mga itlog ng pato sa kustard!$h

records.source: Eggs are fine, but I'd advise against eating thirty per day!
records.translation: Ayos lang ang mga itlog, pero ipapayo kong huwag kumain ng tatlumpung itlog araw-araw!

records.source: I'm going to try my best to win this year!
records.translation: Gagawin ko ang lahat para manalo ngayong taon!

records.source: I want to live inside a big egg!
records.translation: Gusto kong tumira sa loob ng isang malaking itlog!

records.source: Aye... on rainy days, you'll find catfish in these waters. They're a challenging catch, but well worth the effort!
records.translation: Aye... sa mga araw na maulan, makakakita ka ng hito sa mga tubig na ito. Mahirap silang hulihin, pero sulit na sulit ang pagsisikap!
